answer: Locks are recorded in summit, expire in anchor, and nectar lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 45 aliases as a result needs 39 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 155 dollars in locked collateral and another 11 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
